_note: Holiday push posts (Todd, Nov 21 2026): Black Friday, Small Business Saturday and the five Victorian Christmas days, the day before, the day of and the day after. Each posts once, on its date, in its What's New slot (am ~10 AM, pm ~8 PM Pacific), ahead of the regular What's New queue. boost = Todd's own pick list (he boosts by hand in Meta); never printed. hat = add the Hat Store line with the publisher disclosure. No em-dashes. art = social/holiday/art/NAME.svg. link = page on nevadacitynugget.com.

posts.head: Skip the Mall. Walk Broad Street.
posts.deck: Black Friday and Small Business Saturday in downtown Nevada City: gas lamps, cedar garland, and shops run by the people behind the counter.
posts.body: Tomorrow is Black Friday, and Saturday is Small Business Saturday. Downtown Nevada City is a better place to spend them than any parking lot: Gold Rush brick, gas lamps, and dozens of independent shops within a few blocks. Tomorrow's Nugget lists who is open and what they're up to, free, by 6 AM.

posts.head: Black Friday, Nevada City Style
posts.deck: Today's Nugget has the Shop Small Weekend box: downtown hours and specials, straight from the merchants.
posts.body: No doorbusters, no stampede. Downtown Nevada City does Black Friday on foot: hats, books, rocks and gems, art, chocolate, wine, and lunch somewhere with a fireplace. Today's Nugget lists who is open and any specials, as the merchants sent them. Nobody pays to be listed.

posts.head: Today, Every Dollar Stays in Town
posts.deck: Small Business Saturday on Broad, Commercial, Pine and Main. The Saturday farmers market runs in Union Alley till 1.
posts.body: Small Business Saturday is the day to buy your gifts from a neighbor. Start at the farmers market in Union Alley (8:30 AM to 1 PM, per the Chamber), then work your way up Broad Street. Today's Nugget has the Shop Small Weekend box: who is open and what's special.

posts.head: Thanks for Shopping Small. Next Up: Victorian Christmas.
posts.deck: The gas lamps get their cedar and the carolers get their bonnets. Victorian Christmas starts next Sunday, Dec. 6.
posts.body: Thank you to everyone who spent Thanksgiving weekend downtown. Next Sunday, Dec. 6, Nevada City turns into Victorian Christmas, as it has every December since 1978: five days, Sundays Dec. 6, 13 and 20 from 1:30 to 6 PM and Wednesdays Dec. 9 and 16 from 5 to 9 PM. Our guide has parking, shuttles, food and what to see.

posts.head: Victorian Christmas Starts Tomorrow
posts.deck: Sunday, Dec. 6, 1:30 to 6 PM, downtown Nevada City. Gas lamps, carolers, roasted chestnuts and Father Christmas.
posts.body: The first of five days is tomorrow, Sunday, Dec. 6, from 1:30 to 6 PM. Broad and Commercial streets close to traffic, more than 100 artisan vendors set up, and Father Christmas walks the streets (Sundays only, per the Chamber). Downtown parking is scarce. The Chamber's shuttles run from the Rood Center, 950 Maidu Ave., and Bodhi Hive, 420 Providence Mine Rd.: $8, free under 15, free in Victorian costume, rides back free. Everything you need is in our free guide.

posts.head: Today: Victorian Christmas, 1:30 to 6
posts.deck: Opening afternoon. Free roasted chestnuts at the Food Court fire pit, Father Christmas on the streets, the town tree in Robinson Plaza.
posts.body: Victorian Christmas opens today, 1:30 to 6 PM, rain or shine. Look for free roasted chestnuts at the Food Court fire pit, the Dickens Village display in the windows at 210 Broad, the 25-foot town tree in Robinson Plaza, 132 Main, and Father Christmas. Downtown parking is scarce. The Chamber's shuttles run from the Rood Center, 950 Maidu Ave., and Bodhi Hive, 420 Providence Mine Rd.: $8, free under 15, free in Victorian costume, rides back free.

posts.head: Missed Sunday? Come Wednesday Night.
posts.deck: The first evening by gaslight is Wednesday, Dec. 9, from 5 to 9 PM.
posts.body: Thank you to everyone who came out for opening day. If Sunday afternoon didn't work, Wednesday night might be better anyway: Victorian Christmas by gaslight, Wednesday, Dec. 9, from 5 to 9 PM. The guide has shuttles, restrooms, food and drink.

posts.head: Tomorrow Night, the Gas Lamps Get Busy
posts.deck: Victorian Christmas by gaslight: Wednesday, Dec. 9, 5 to 9 PM, downtown Nevada City.
posts.body: The first of two Wednesday nights is tomorrow, Dec. 9, from 5 to 9 PM: carolers, vendors, shops open late, and every gas lamp on Broad Street wrapped in cedar. Downtown parking is scarce. The Chamber's shuttles run from the Rood Center, 950 Maidu Ave., and Bodhi Hive, 420 Providence Mine Rd.: $8, free under 15, free in Victorian costume, rides back free. Dress for a mountain December.

posts.head: Tonight: Victorian Christmas by Gaslight
posts.deck: 5 to 9 PM, downtown Nevada City. Shops stay open late; the chestnuts are on the fire.
posts.body: Tonight from 5 to 9 PM, Victorian Christmas lights up downtown: carolers in Victorian dress, more than 100 artisan vendors, boutique shops open late, and free roasted chestnuts at the Food Court fire pit. Downtown parking is scarce. The Chamber's shuttles run from the Rood Center, 950 Maidu Ave., and Bodhi Hive, 420 Providence Mine Rd.: $8, free under 15, free in Victorian costume, rides back free.

posts.head: Two Down, Three to Go
posts.body: Thank you for a fine first night. Three days of Victorian Christmas remain: Sunday, Dec. 13 (1:30 to 6 PM), Wednesday, Dec. 16 (5 to 9 PM) and Sunday, Dec. 20 (1:30 to 6 PM). Plan your trip with the guide.

posts.head: Tomorrow: Father Christmas Walks Broad Street
posts.deck: Victorian Christmas, Sunday, Dec. 13, 1:30 to 6 PM. Bring the kids, a scarf and an appetite.
posts.body: Tomorrow, Sunday, Dec. 13, Victorian Christmas returns from 1:30 to 6 PM. Kids can visit Santa for a picture, Father Christmas makes his Sunday rounds, and the Walking Christmas Tree wanders the streets on clear days, per the Chamber. Downtown parking is scarce. The Chamber's shuttles run from the Rood Center, 950 Maidu Ave., and Bodhi Hive, 420 Providence Mine Rd.: $8, free under 15, free in Victorian costume, rides back free.

posts.head: Today: Victorian Christmas, 1:30 to 6
posts.deck: Santa for the kids, Father Christmas on the streets, chestnuts by the fire.
posts.body: Victorian Christmas is on today from 1:30 to 6 PM, rain or shine. Santa takes pictures with the kids, Father Christmas walks the streets, the Dickens Village fills the windows at 210 Broad, and the Food Court fire pit roasts free chestnuts. Downtown parking is scarce. The Chamber's shuttles run from the Rood Center, 950 Maidu Ave., and Bodhi Hive, 420 Providence Mine Rd.: $8, free under 15, free in Victorian costume, rides back free.

posts.head: One More Night by Gaslight
posts.deck: The last Wednesday evening is Dec. 16, 5 to 9 PM.
posts.body: Thank you, Sunday crowd. The second and last Wednesday night of Victorian Christmas is Dec. 16, from 5 to 9 PM, and the final afternoon is Sunday, Dec. 20. The guide has shuttles, restrooms, food and where to stay.

posts.head: Tomorrow: The Last Night by Gaslight
posts.deck: Victorian Christmas, Wednesday, Dec. 16, 5 to 9 PM. The final evening of 2026.
posts.body: Tomorrow, Wednesday, Dec. 16, is the last Victorian Christmas evening this year, 5 to 9 PM. Carolers, chestnuts, shops open late, and Nevada City's gas lamps doing what they do best. Downtown parking is scarce. The Chamber's shuttles run from the Rood Center, 950 Maidu Ave., and Bodhi Hive, 420 Providence Mine Rd.: $8, free under 15, free in Victorian costume, rides back free.

posts.head: Tonight: The Last Gaslight Evening
posts.deck: 5 to 9 PM, downtown Nevada City. Last chance for an evening visit this year.
posts.body: Tonight, 5 to 9 PM, is the final Wednesday night of Victorian Christmas 2026. Walk Broad Street under cedar garland, pick up a last gift from a downtown shop, and warm your hands at the chestnut fire. Downtown parking is scarce. The Chamber's shuttles run from the Rood Center, 950 Maidu Ave., and Bodhi Hive, 420 Providence Mine Rd.: $8, free under 15, free in Victorian costume, rides back free.

posts.head: One Sunday Left
posts.deck: The final afternoon of Victorian Christmas is Sunday, Dec. 20, 1:30 to 6 PM.
posts.body: Thank you for two fine Wednesday nights. Victorian Christmas has one afternoon left: Sunday, Dec. 20, from 1:30 to 6 PM, the last one before Christmas. Plan it with the guide.

posts.head: Tomorrow Is the Last Victorian Christmas of 2026
posts.deck: Sunday, Dec. 20, 1:30 to 6 PM. Five days, one left.
posts.body: Last call: Victorian Christmas wraps up tomorrow, Sunday, Dec. 20, from 1:30 to 6 PM, five days before Christmas. Father Christmas, carolers, chestnuts, and downtown shops for the last gifts on your list. Downtown parking is scarce. The Chamber's shuttles run from the Rood Center, 950 Maidu Ave., and Bodhi Hive, 420 Providence Mine Rd.: $8, free under 15, free in Victorian costume, rides back free.

posts.head: Today: The Last Victorian Christmas Afternoon
posts.deck: 1:30 to 6 PM, downtown Nevada City. See you next December.
posts.body: The 2026 Victorian Christmas ends today, 1:30 to 6 PM, rain or shine. Visit Santa, find Father Christmas, try a roasted chestnut, and finish your shopping downtown. Downtown parking is scarce. The Chamber's shuttles run from the Rood Center, 950 Maidu Ave., and Bodhi Hive, 420 Providence Mine Rd.: $8, free under 15, free in Victorian costume, rides back free.

posts.head: Thank You, Victorian Christmas Crowds
posts.deck: Five days of gaslight, done. Nevada City will be here all winter.
posts.body: That's Victorian Christmas 2026. Thank you to the Chamber, the merchants, the carolers, the shuttle drivers and everyone who came. Nevada City doesn't close for the season: the Nugget is free every morning with what's on, from shows to shop news.
